insights.headline: Rupee sinks to two-month low ahead of RBI policy as gold holds near $4,160; analysts split on the yield premium
insights.summary: The rupee slid to a two-month low as the global bond rout deepened and crude topped $100, pushing domestic gold toward ₹1.50 lakh per 10 grams on the MCX with the RBI's October 7 policy in focus. Internationally, gold held near $4,160 while a Reuters analysis argued the post-2022 debasement premium is entrenched and leaves bullion primed to climb despite 10-year yields at their highest since 2002. Banks are resetting calls: Wells Fargo trimmed its 2027 target while Morgan Stanley's outlook still sees $5,000 gold and a $120 silver run.
points: Rupee at two-month low as US 10-year yield hits highest since 2002; RBI policy due October 7.
MCX gold futures touched ₹1,50,511/10g on firm spot demand; silver jumped over ₹2,800.
MKS PAMP's Shiels: ~$840/oz debasement premium entrenched; gold primed to climb. (Reuters)
Wells Fargo cuts 2027 gold target to $5,200–$5,400; Morgan Stanley still sees $5,000 in H2 2027.
Friday's US payrolls eyed: hot data risks a $4,100/$4,000 test; cool data could lift gold toward $4,400.

trending.title: Yields vs. gold: the premium debate
trending.summary: Gold holds near $4,160 as 10-year yields hit multi-decade highs; MKS PAMP's Shiels says the entrenched debasement premium leaves gold primed to climb despite September's 8.5% slide.

trending.title: Rupee's slide raises the local price of gold
trending.summary: The rupee's drop to a two-month low lifts what Indian buyers pay even when global prices stall: MCX gold is near ₹1.50 lakh/10g with the RBI's October 7 decision looming.

trending.title: Banks reset their gold calls
trending.summary: Wells Fargo cut its 2027 gold target to $5,200–$5,400 on Fed-hike and dollar worries; Morgan Stanley still sees $5,000 gold in H2 2027 and $120 silver; Goldman expects the next Fed hike in December.

trending.title: Silver's $60 test
trending.summary: Silver is hovering just above $60 after September's 13.5% slide, with analysts watching whether the level holds as yields stay elevated — while longer-term bulls still talk $120.

trending.title: Festive demand takes the spotlight
trending.summary: With Dhanteras and Diwali approaching, jewellers expect resilient festive buying even at elevated prices, with shoppers shifting to lighter pieces and old-gold exchanges.

items.title: Rupee drops to two-month low as global bond rout deepens, oil jumps
items.summary: The rupee fell 0.5% to 96.3150 per dollar, its weakest in two months and sharpest single-day drop in over two months, the Economic Times reports. Surging global bond yields and Brent crude reclaiming $100 — after China suspended oil product exports — pressured the currency; dollar sales by state-run banks limited the fall.

items.title: Entrenched premium leaves gold primed to climb despite surge in US bond yields
items.summary: MKS PAMP's Nicky Shiels argues the post-2022 debasement premium in gold, estimated at about $840 an ounce, is now entrenched, leaving bullion primed to climb even as the US 10-year yield hits its highest since 2002. Gold, which hit a record $5,595 in January, was back near $4,161. Shiels points to sustained demand: China imported 1,077 tonnes in the first eight months of 2026.

items.title: Global bond rout hoists benchmark Indian yield to mid-2024 high before RBI policy
items.summary: India's benchmark 10-year yield rose 3 bps to 7.2133% on Thursday, its highest since April 2024, as a global bond selloff cemented expectations of an RBI rate hike next week, the Economic Times reports. The US 10-year at 5.30% has squeezed the spread to the tightest in over a year; the RBI is expected to deliver its first hike in nearly four years on October 7.

items.title: Gold futures rise to ₹1.50 lakh/10 gm on firm spot demand
items.summary: Gold for October delivery on the MCX rose ₹1,475, or 0.99%, to ₹1,50,511 per 10 grams as speculators built fresh positions on firm spot demand, PTI reports. Gold futures in New York gained 0.59% to $4,182.06 an ounce.

items.title: Gold rises ₹607 as rate-hold expectations strengthen; silver jumps ₹2,828
items.summary: MCX gold futures rose ₹607 to about ₹1,49,434 per 10 grams while silver’s December contract jumped ₹2,828 to about ₹2,25,680 per kg, Business Standard reports. Lower-than-expected US inflation data strengthened expectations that the Fed will hold rates, with Comex gold trading near $4,200 an ounce.

items.title: Wells Fargo resets gold price target amid rate concern
items.summary: Wells Fargo Investment Institute trimmed its 2027 year-end gold target to $5,200–$5,400 an ounce from $5,400–$5,600, citing Fed rate hikes and a stronger dollar. The bank still expects gold to end 2027 higher than today, noting central-bank buying picked back up after the first quarter and ETF flows have been positive since July.

items.title: Gold price will break $5,000/oz in H2 2027, and silver's run to $120 was driven by more than hype – Morgan Stanley's Gower
items.summary: Morgan Stanley's Amy Gower expects gold to trade back above $5,000/oz within a year, citing strong central-bank and ETF demand — she notes China's gold imports are on track for their highest since 2017. She sees support above $4,000/oz as fiscal-sustainability worries underpin prices, and says silver's run to $120 was driven by more than hype.

items.title: US September Nonfarm Payrolls Preview: Job Growth May Cool, How Will US Stocks, Dollar and Gold React?
items.summary: Friday's US jobs report is the next big test for gold: a Reuters survey sees about 100,000 new jobs with unemployment ticking up to 4.2%. TradingKey maps the scenarios — a hot report could push gold to test $4,100 and $4,000, while a cool one could open a recovery toward $4,400 — alongside the read-through for US stocks and the dollar.

items.title: Goldman Sachs pushes Fed rate hike forecast to December
items.summary: Goldman Sachs pushed its next-hike call to December after August PCE inflation printed 3.4% versus 3.7% expected, Reuters reports. The brokerage had forecast a 25bp October hike. "We see a strong chance the FOMC will ultimately conclude additional rate hikes are unnecessary," it said. October-hike odds fell to 38% from 71% a week ago, per CME FedWatch. Friday's US nonfarm payrolls report is next.

items.title: IBJA chief Kothari: gold broke $4,250 support, eyes $4,100; silver's $62.5 neckline gives way
items.summary: IBJA president Prithviraj Kothari says gold and silver slid further ahead of the US jobs report, with monthly losses of 8.5% and 13.5%. Softer August PCE cut October-hike odds to 38%, though a December hike is priced at 87%. Technically both metals look weak: gold broke $4,250 support with $4,100 and $4,000 next; silver cracked its $62.5 neckline, with $60 and $57 next.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD seems vulnerable near $60 amid soaring US Treasury Yields
items.summary: Spot silver slipped about 1.5% to a four-week low near $60 as the 10-year US Treasury yield hit a fresh two-decade high near 5.3%, FXStreet reports. Traders trimmed bets on a hawkish Fed after soft US inflation data, and the technical picture stays bearish below $62.19 resistance.

items.title: How Trump's Gold Tariffs Created a $100 NY-London Basis Gap
items.summary: A deep dive into how US gold tariff moves opened a $100-an-ounce premium of New York futures over London spot: CBP's 39% bar reclassification in July 2025, a 0% order that September, and the February 2026 Supreme Court ruling that replaced tariffs with 10%/15% rates, plus the WGC's January 2026 IEEPA investment-gold exemption.

items.title: Gold, silver prices edge higher: How festive demand could shape the outlook
items.summary: Domestic gold and silver futures edged higher ahead of Dhanteras and Diwali, CNBC-TV18 reports, quoting analysts on how festive demand could shape the near-term price outlook.

items.title: Gold price future roadmap: 6% September fall meets Diwali demand hopes
items.summary: Gold fell about 6.5% in September, its worst month since June, after Fed tightening and a 10-year US yield at 5.293% — highest since 2007, Mint reports. Brickwork Ratings' Rajeev Sharan expects firm but range-bound prices through Dussehra, Dhanteras, Diwali and winter wedding demand; Monarch PMS' Dhruv Joglekar points to festive physical buying plus central-bank accumulation.

items.title: BOK to add gold to its coffers for the first time since 2013
items.summary: The Bank of Korea will buy about one metric ton of domestically produced gold in December — its first physical purchase since February 2013, Aju Press reports. A settlement system completes December 14; the gold will be bought in won via KRX/KSD from domestic output. The BOK held 104.4 tonnes at end-August and resumed gold exposure via a $250 million gold ETF position in Q2.

items.title: Rupee to fall more, yield curve to shift higher in H2FY27: Gaura Sengupta
items.summary: IDFC First Bank chief economist Gaura Sengupta expects the rupee to depreciate further in H2FY27 as RBI intervention turns more cautious now that the FCNR(B) window has closed — the $133 billion mobilised is borrowed money to be repaid in three years. Persistent dollar strength and high US yields keep foreign capital away, pushing the G-sec yield curve higher.

items.title: Unscrupulous jewellers may use fake stamps to mark your gold: GJC flags fraud risk as hallmarking charges rise
items.summary: Jewellery hallmarking charges rose 67% from Rs 45 to Rs 75 per article, and the Gem and Jewellery Domestic Council has warned the hike could push unscrupulous jewellers — especially in smaller cities — toward fake hallmark stamps, the Times of India reports. GJC has raised the concern with the consumer affairs minister and BIS.

items.title: SGB premature redemption October 2026: 4 tranches eligible for early exit
items.summary: RBI scheduled premature redemption for four SGB tranches — 2019-20 Series V and VI and 2020-21 Series I and VII, Livemint reports. Deadlines: Oct 5 (Series V, redeems Oct 15), Oct 9 (Series VII, Oct 19), Oct 19 (Series I, Oct 28), Oct 21 (Series VI, Oct 30). Value uses IBJA's 3-day 999-gold average. From FY27 the capital-gains exemption applies only if held to maturity, so early exit may be taxed.

items.title: Gold Down 8.5% in Sept, Silver -13.5% as Real Yields 'Re-Price Fast'
items.summary: Gold fell 8.5% and silver 13.5% in September as real yields repriced sharply higher, BullionVault reports. Inflation-protected 10-year Treasury yields jumped the most in four years to near a record high — the most negative nine-month gold-real-yield stretch since 2020. Conventional 10-year yields still offered 5.24% at month-end after their steepest monthly rise since September 2023.
